title: Thistle's Jewellery Store, Orser St.. (Later tourist bureau)
description: Behind the C. Humphrey Taylor block on Orser Street stood a small building with two retail shops. The left side once housed the town's first lending library, a meat shop, and a jewellery store, while the right side was a barber shop run by Harold and Weldon Bradley. Before its demolition in 1982, the building was home to the Carleton Craft Gift Shop and Tourist Information Centre.
